newsitem.title: MEXICO: Mexico's Cofar begins trading on Mexican bourse.
newsitem.headline: Mexico's Cofar begins trading on Mexican bourse.

text.p: Mexican pharmaceutical company Controladora de Farmacias SA (Cofar) has begun trading on the Mexican Stock Exchange (Bolsa), the company said.
Cofar had been trading on the Market for Small and Medium Size companies.
The company is a chain of 62 drugstores concentrated mainly in the central region of the country and in Mexico City.

It has a total number of outstanding shares equal to 24,559,160 divided into two series: the A series which represents 51 percent of shareholders equity of the company and the B series which represents the remaining 49 percent.
Total market capitalisation of the company is $38 million using a price of 12.5 pesos per share and an exchange rate of eight per dollar.
